_comment: Example ck:quality report. One report is written per --gate/--verify call, or per --audit call with --save. Not a JSON-Schema document — an annotated canonical instance, matching this pack's plan-schema.json convention.
_target: phase file stem (no extension) for gate/verify, e.g. phase-02-receipt-gate for phase-02-receipt-gate.md; path, diff ref, or 'working-tree' for audit/diff/changed. The receipt this report yields, if any, is derived from this exact string.
_verdict_rule: APPROVED requires zero open findings with severity BLOCKER or HIGH, and zero open MEDIUM findings where introduced_by_current_change is true. audit mode still computes a verdict but it is informational only — it never blocks anything by itself.
_reviewed_files: Exact file list the reviewer actually read and evaluated. This is what a later receipt (added by the completion-gate phase) hashes against.

findings._rule: Stable rule ID from core-contract.md or adapters.md — never a paraphrase.
findings._introduced_by_current_change: true = new in this diff/phase; false = pre-existing debt the reviewer is only noting, not blocking on (unless BLOCKER/HIGH).
findings.why_it_matters: Two implementations of the same business rule will drift and produce inconsistent eligibility decisions.
findings.required_action: Reuse the existing domain policy instead of reimplementing it here.

findings.evidence: Pre-existing 140-line function mixing pricing calculation and logging.
findings.why_it_matters: Pre-existing debt; not something this phase introduced or is scoped to fix.
findings.required_action: Out of scope for this phase — track separately if it becomes a blocker for future work.

_report_path: Set only when the report is actually written to disk (--gate always; --audit/--diff/--changed only with --save <path>).
